name: test-audit
description: Authoring gate and evidence-first audit workflow for tests: junk patterns, retention bar, containment before pruning, and preservation proof before any deletion, with an always-on nudge. Adapted from OpenClaw (MIT).

interface.shortDescription: Authoring gate and evidence-first audit for tests
interface.longDescription: Gates every new or changed test on the behavior it protects and the regression it catches, audits existing tests for junk patterns with a complete evidence record, contains external side effects before pruning, and requires the remaining test to catch a representative fault before a duplicate is deleted.
defaultPrompt: Run the test-audit authoring gate on the tests I just added.
Audit the tests in this module and classify each one with evidence.
